verses.gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਖੜ ਖਾਤ ਖਲ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਮੋਨ ਕੋ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਪੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: pasoo khaR khaat khal sabadh surat heen mon ko mahaatam pai a(n)mirat pravaeh jee ||

en.bdb: An animal eats green grass and hay. He is bereft of all knowledge of Lord's word. Due to his inability to speak, gives nectar-like milk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਮਾਨਸ ਮੁਖ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੀਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੀ ਤਾਹਿ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: naanaa misaTaan khaan paan maanas mukh rasanaa raseelee hoi soiee bhalee taeh jee ||

en.bdb: A man eats and enjoys many types of food materials with his tongue but he becomes praiseworthy only if his tongue is sweetened with the sweetness of Lord's name.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਫਲ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਪਸੁ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਆਹਿ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: bachan bibek Tek maanas janam fal bachan bihoon pas paramit aaeh jee ||

en.bdb: Purpose of human life is to take refuge in the meditation of His Naam. But one devoid of the teachings of the True Guru is the worst kind of animal.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਗਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਹੀਨ ਬਿਖ ਧਰ ਬਿਖਮ ਚਕਤ ਚਿਤ ਚਾਹਿ ਜੀ ॥੨੦੨॥
verses.translit_en: maanas janam gat bachan bibek heen bikh dhar bikham chakat chit chaeh jee ||202||

en.bdb: One who is bereft of teachings of True Guru, craves and wanders in search of worldly pleasure and remains vexed for their acquisition. His state is like a dangerous poisonous snake. (202)
